The plate looks like a side plate of about 24 cm in the image, roughly 610 px wide, so about 0.039 cm per px... in other words about 25 px per cm.

The ribs are a small rack section of about 2-3 ribs. One piece measures about 450 px long, or 18 cm, and about 3.5 cm wide. The other piece is partly hidden behind it. Together they are about 150-180 g of ribs with bone. Pork ribs with sauce run about 250 kcal per 100 g edible, and bone makes up about 35% of the weight. That gives roughly 110 g edible, or about 300 kcal.

The roll is about 17 cm long and 5 cm wide, so about 70-80 g. At roughly 270 kcal per 100 g, that is about 200 kcal.

Total weight is about 160 + 75 = 235 g, and total energy is about 500 kcal.
